sources.snippet: This repository is your one-stop resource for mastering Agentic AI, a domain of artificial intelligence that focuses on building autonomous AI agents. From understanding the foundational concepts to building industry-ready AI agents, this repository includes blogs, tutorials, and projects to guide you every step of the way. Let us get started!

sources.title: GPT‑5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
sources.snippet: GPT‑5.6 spans three model tiers: Sol, our flagship; Terra, a lower-cost model with performance competitive with GPT‑5.5; and Luna, our fastest and most affordable model.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 SOL Jailbreaks and Agentic Cyber Risk - penligent.ai
sources.snippet: OpenAI confirmed that GPT-5.6 faced universal jailbreaks during pre-deployment cyber testing. Learn what the 83% result really means, how agentic capabilities change the risk, and how defenders should test and contain AI systems.
